sources.text: I want to share an AI-powered Telegram booking architecture I built for beauty salons using self-hosted n8n, PostgreSQL, and Google Gemini .
taskExcerpts: I want to share an AI-powered Telegram booking architecture I built for beauty salons using self-hosted n8n, PostgreSQL, and Google Gemini .

spans.text: I want to share an AI-powered Telegram booking architecture I built for beauty salons using self-hosted n8n, PostgreSQL, and Google Gemini .

Many AI booking assistants fail in production because LLMs can hallucinate relative dates (“next Friday”) or register double-bookings. To solve this, I applied a strict separation of concerns: The LLM is responsible ONLY for natural language intent extraction, while deterministic code (n8n JS nodes) and SQL queries handle all calendar logic and validations.
Atomic Slot Validation: Every booking request checks salon working hours, master availability, and existing appointments in PostgreSQL at the SQL level before confirmation.

Orchestration: n8n (self-hosted Docker on VPS) Database & CRM: PostgreSQL (schema: ai_agent_booking ) + NocoDB interface AI Model: Google Gemini ( gemini-2.5-flash ) via LangChain Node Interface: Telegram Bot API Feel free to check out live demonstrations and system details on my portfolio: My Portfolio Landing Page I’d love to hear your thoughts on this architecture! How do you usually handle LLM intent validation in your n8n workflows?

spans.text: Sharing a simple pattern I use for tracking hiring at target companies. Workflow: Schedule Trigger (daily) → Apify node (“Run an Actor and get dataset”) → IF item count > 0 → Slack. In the Apify node, run the Actor birchwood-data/ats-job-scraper with input like:

For Workday career sites use birchwood-data/workday-jobs-scraper the same way. In the Slack node, post {{$json.title}} – {{$json.location}} – {{$json.url}} . Because the Actor remembers which jobs it has already seen between runs, each run returns only new postings, so no dedupe logic is needed in n8n. A quiet day costs almost nothing, since the Actors are pay-per-result (Workday is $0.002 per returned job). Actors: Greenhouse, Lever & Ashby Job Scraper | ATS Jobs API · Apify and Workday Jobs Scraper | myworkdayjobs.com API · Apify Disclosure: I built both Actors. sources.title: n8n Information Extractor schema documentation · product evidence
sources.text: Use the Information Extractor node to extract structured information from incoming data. On this page, you'll find the node parameters for the Information Extractor node, and links to more resources. Node parameters Text defines the input text to extract information from. This is usually an expression that references a field from the input items. For example, this could be {{ $json.chatInput }} if the input is a chat trigger, or {{ $json.text }} if a previous node is Extract from PDF. Use Schema Type to choose how you want to describe the desired output data format. You can choose between: From Attribute Descriptions : This option allows you to define the schema by specifying the list of attributes and their descriptions. Generate From JSON Example : Input an example JSON object to automatically generate the schema. The node uses the object property types and names. It ignores the actual values. n8n treats every field as mandatory when generating schemas from JSON examples. Define using JSON Schema : Manually input the JSON schema. Read the JSON Schema guides and examples for help creating a valid JSON schema.
